description: Editable A-X-HK media command manifest. Add/rename media commands here; each command must map to an existing supported platform.
notes: Edit only valid JSON; comments are not allowed.
Set enabled=false to disable a media command without deleting it.
name and aliases are typed after the bot prefix.
platform must be one of the built-in public-media platforms or download.
This manifest does not enable private/login/DRM access or any bypass system.
